component.name: mcp-server-filesystem
component.summary: MCP server exposing Linux filesystem operations

description.p: An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing Linux filesystem operations as tools for an LLM agent, built on fastmcp.

Tools cover directory listing, file reading, stat, existence checks, and glob search, read-only by default, plus file writes, mkdir, delete, move, and copy, gated behind FS_READONLY=false. All paths are confined to FS_ROOT, read once from the environment at startup.
